D005-D010_h001.question:

At the same time, these… strange things started. I’m absolutely sure something catastrophic is about to happen, like the whole world is about to collapse or just stop existing, and that I’m one of the few who really sees it. When I’m in that state, I see shadows and figures out of the corner of my eye—people standing in doorways or in the street—and when I look straight at them, they’re gone. Sometimes I see the sky crack or buildings crumbling, like a preview of the end.

When my mood quiets down a bit—on the rare days I’m less amped up—those visions and end-of-the-world beliefs back off. They only seem to kick in when I’m in that high, revved‑up phase.
